_comment: Curated classification sidecar for the NativeCompat flag registry. Hand-authored — NOT generated. Joined against scripts/analysis/native_compat_census.py's `scan` output by `gen` to produce NativeCompatFlags.gen.inc + NATIVE_COMPAT_LEDGER.md. Seeded verbatim from docs/native/engine-arch-review-2026-07-05/06-arch-crosscut.md §3.1 (a)/(b) and execution/W0.6/PLAN.md's 'Authoritative flag classification' section. Every flag not listed here that the scanner finds gets class=unknown (a NEEDS-CLASSIFICATION row in the ledger) — do not invent entries for flags that don't exist in source.
